messages:
Priya: Quick triage: Nebula-7B-lite intake into int4 shows severe dropout on long-context summarization after our rotary+quant pipeline. Suspect head-interleave + vocab_base handling.

Priya: Baseline (fp16) LongSum-500 F1=0.81; after int4 conv F1=0.52. Perplexity increased 11->18.

Luca: Which conversion flags + tokenmap did you use? Did you pull rotary angles from model metadata or recompute?

Priya: `tools/convert_nebula.py --ckpt nebula/7b-lite.pt --out nebula-7b.onnx --rotary=concat --quant=int4 --vocab-map nebula->unified.json`

Priya: tokenmap excerpt: {"token_offset":1,"pad":0}.

Sam: Common pattern: some checkpoints store heads interleaved. If converter reshapes without transpose, angles get mixed across heads. That mainly affects long context.

Luca: Dump first few rotary angle blocks from ckpt and converted artifact and compare. Use `tools/dump_rotary` helper.

Priya: quick dump shows conv head0 pattern matches orig head2 and values appear scaled (conv stride doubled). So two issues: head permutation and frequency scaling.

Sam: Fix idea: detect permutation by computing correlation matrix between converted and original head vectors and then reorder. Also detect scale factor by median ratio and correct. Add guard threshold so we don't reorder on noisy matches.

Luca: Implemented local patch: `angles = angles.reshape(n_heads,-1)` then compute `perm = np.argmax(np.abs(angles @ orig.T),axis=1)` and reorder; apply scale correction if median ratio ~2. Ran int4 conv after patch.

Priya: After patch: F1=0.68 PPX~13. Remaining gap likely from quantizing embeddings/proj or LN folding.

Sam: Run int8 and bf16 conversions to separate quant noise vs serialization bug. Also run token sanity check: sample sentence token ids must match expected after applying token_offset once.

Priya: Found we applied token_offset twice in remapping code for Nebula. Fixed that. With both fixes: F1=0.73 PPX=12.4.

Luca: Do an ablation: keep embeddings+output projection fp16 while body int4 to see if gap closes. If yes, add layer allowlist.

Priya: Ablation result: embeds+proj fp16 + body int4 -> F1=0.78, nearly baseline. Good candidate for allowlist.

build-bot: CI queued: service=converter, branch=luca/nebula-rotary-fix, env=nebula-canary. ETA ~5m.

Sam: Add unit test `tests/test_rotary_perm_scale.py` that creates synthetic interleaved tensor and verifies detection recovers order+scale. Also add small embedding stability test.

Luca: I'll push PR with `--fp16-proj` flag and enable head-perm detection by default. Will run canary and then update int4 recipes for Nebula family.

Priya: Filing issue with dumps and eval runs. Thanks all.
